room_rent.display: Up to limit in Policy Schedule
room_rent.note: VERIFY: room rent up to limits specified in Policy Schedule; proportionate deductions apply if higher room opted

icu.note: Proportionate deductions not applicable for ICU charges

copayment.note: Mandatory co-payment applies only if opted on Policy Schedule; zone-based co-pay for treatment in higher zone; Waiver of Mandatory Co-payment available

sub_limits.note: VERIFY: Platinum-Essential variant applies treatment-wise sub-limits (e.g. cataract Rs 40k); mainstream variant has none

deductible.note: VERIFY: aggregate deductible not found in base wording

ped_waiting.note: VERIFY: PED waiting months stated in Policy Schedule; IRDAI max 36 months; reducible to extent of prior coverage on portability

maternity.note: Maternity Expenses optional; 48-month waiting; surrogacy complications cover within 36 months

cumulative_bonus.note: VERIFY: Cumulative Bonus capped at 100% of SI; per-year accrual rate per Policy Schedule; reduced on claim

restoration.note: Reload of SI once/yr, not for same illness; Super Reload (unlimited times, incl. same illness) available per Policy Schedule

pre_hosp.note: VERIFY: pre-hospitalisation days as per Policy Schedule

post_hosp.note: VERIFY: post-hospitalisation days as per Policy Schedule

ambulance.note: VERIFY: road ambulance cover limit per Policy Schedule

modern_treatments.note: Modern Treatment Methods and Advancement in Technologies covered

consumables.note: VERIFY: consumables/non-medical items cover not confirmed in base wording

grace_period.note: VERIFY: grace period as per IRDAI / Policy Schedule

notable_exclusions.display: Standard IRDAI exclusions (Excl01-18); zone-based co-pay for higher-zone treatment

optional_riders.display: Maternity Expenses, Waiver of Mandatory Co-payment, Personal Accident, Critical Illness, PPN discount
